narration:0:1910524001:1.text: Soon, members of the other clans arrive in response to the summons.
narration:0:1910524001:1.male: Soon, members of the other clans arrive in response to the summons.
narration:0:1910524001:1.female: Soon, members of the other clans arrive in response to the summons.

say:2:1910524002:1.text: Matriarch Menoa, we have come at your call.
say:2:1910524002:1.source_cn: 摩淖亚，我们应你的召集而来。

say:3:1910524003:1.text: You would have us sing together to speak with the Tidewarden?
say:3:1910524003:1.source_cn: 你要我们一同唱响乐曲，与波涛长者对话？

say:4:1910524004:1.text: This is the only thing we can do.
say:4:1910524004:1.source_cn: 这是我们唯一能做的事。

say:5:1910524005:1.text: We grieve for the loss of our kin, and we are troubled by the shifting of the currents. I understand you. I am as sorrowful and confused as you are.
say:5:1910524005:1.source_cn: 我们为族人的离去而哀恸，为洋流的变动而困惑。我理解你，...

say:6:1910524006:1.text: But here and now, you must stay level-headed amidst this chaos. You must know that this is a futile attempt.
say:6:1910524006:1.source_cn: 但此时此刻，你更要保持理智。你应当清楚，这只是无用的尝试。

say:7:1910524007:1.text: In all our records, the Tidewarden has never once answered the songs of Coralia. Do you really think it will listen this time?
say:7:1910524007:1.source_cn: 摩淖亚，在你的记录中，波涛长者从未回应过塔拉萨的歌声。...

say:8:1910524008:1.text: I know this request comes from your new clan members, but they do not yet truly know Coralia.
say:8:1910524008:1.source_cn: 虽然这是你新家人的请求，但他们毕竟还不了解塔拉萨。

say:9:1910524009:1.text: My friends, let us try. As elders, could you really bear to watch our children be swallowed by this glowing tide that has appeared from nowhere?
say:9:1910524009:1.source_cn: 我的老朋友们，试试吧。身为长辈，你们难道忍心看着子嗣被...

say:10:1910524010:1.text: When we were young, how many times did we sit around the Tidewarden's reef and sing together?
say:10:1910524010:1.source_cn: 咱们年轻的时候，曾经多少次围坐在波涛长者的礁岩上一起歌唱啊。

say:11:1910524011:1.text: Have the currents washed away the hearts that once dared to try?
say:11:1910524011:1.source_cn: 海流将你们那曾经勇于尝试的心冲刷走了吗？

say:14:1910524014:1.text: New members of the Seamoon Clan... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Tolan, step forward.
say:14:1910524014:1.male: New members of the Seamoon Clan... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Tolan, step forward.
say:14:1910524014:1.female: New members of the Seamoon Clan... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Tolan, step forward.

say:15:1910524015:1.text: Do you know the Song of Choices?

say:20:1910524017:1.text: The Song of Choices is our means of speaking with the sea. It is the melody by which we ask the currents to guide our fate.
say:20:1910524017:1.source_cn: 抉择之歌，是我们与大海沟通的媒介，是寻求洋流指引命运的乐曲。

say:21:1910524018:1.text: As you wish, Matriarch Menoa. I will lead the Tidesong Clan in singing the Song of Choices.
say:21:1910524018:1.source_cn: 摩淖亚，如你所愿，我会引领潮音家族唱响抉择之歌。

say:22:1910524019:1.text: Members of the other clans! Listen closely and join our chorus. Those who carry instruments may play them.
say:22:1910524019:1.source_cn: 其余家族的族人，仔细聆听后，加入我们的合唱。有乐器者，...

say:23:1910524020:1.text: I will use my voice-carrying gift to send our music as far as I can.
say:23:1910524020:1.source_cn: 我会用传音天赋，尽最大力量将乐声传递出去。

say:24:1910524021:1.text: Relax, children. Just follow our melody.
say:24:1910524021:1.source_cn: 放轻松，孩子们，合着我们的旋律就好。

say:25:1910524022:1.text: My little jelly, keep your spirits up, alright?
say:25:1910524022:1.source_cn: 小浪花，打起精神来，好吗？

say:29:1910524024:1.text: May the currents bless us and let the Tidewarden hear our voices.
say:29:1910524024:1.source_cn: 愿洋流保佑，令波涛长者能够听到我们的声音。

choice:19:0:1.text: I had the fortune to hear it once at the gathering grounds.
choice:19:0:1.source_cn: 有幸在集会地听过一次
choice:19:0:1.male: I had the fortune to hear it once at the gathering grounds.
choice:19:0:1.female: I had the fortune to hear it once at the gathering grounds.

choice:19:1:2.text: Play the music. Let the currents guide our fate.
choice:19:1:2.source_cn: 演奏音乐，靠水流来指引命运
choice:19:1:2.male: Play the music. Let the currents guide our fate.
choice:19:1:2.female: Play the music. Let the currents guide our fate.
